description: Check a resource pack (a folder or a .zip in the workspace, /tmp/churn-sfq0snbp), not only ones Texel made: pack.mcmeta and the versions its format covers, file and namespace names, PNGs, .mcmeta animations and GUI scaling, entity texture sizes against Texel's layouts, models, block states, item definitions and particles that point at missing files, and unused textures. Each issue has the file, a JSON path and a fix hint.

mcVersion.description: Minecraft Java version the pack must work on, e.g. "1.21.4".

path.description: The pack folder or .zip, relative to the workspace.

name: texel_check_pack
title: Check resource pack
